slides.texte_overlay:
Little things that make you
the easiest person to chat with
Answering questions with a little extra. Not "Fine" but "Good, I finally finished that bookshelf." A small detail gives the other person something to ask about.
Laughing at the small stuff. A dropped fork, a wrong turn, a strange song. People relax around someone who doesn't take every moment seriously.
Never checking the time while someone talks. Watch, phone, clock on the wall. Every glance tells them you'd rather be somewhere else.
Remembering what they told you last time. "How's the new puppy?" Following up shows you listened, and people love talking to good listeners.
Always having something new to share. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and conversations never run dry when I have fresh stories.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Conversations never run dry when I have fresh stories.

slides.texte_overlay: Being curious about different opinions. "Interesting, why do you see it that way?" Curiosity makes people feel safe to share, even when you disagree.
Ending conversations warmly. "Really enjoyed this, let's do it again." How a chat ends is what people remember the most, so finish it with a smile and their name.
